name: FTX
rootCause: In its official Telegram channel, FTX said it had been compromised, instructing users not to install any new upgrades and to remove all FTX apps. Over $600 million stolen from FTX's crypto wallets.

descriptions.text: In its official Telegram channel, FTX said it had been compromised, instructing users not to install any new upgrades and to remove all FTX apps. Over $600 million stolen from FTX's crypto wallets.

FTX lost hundreds of millions after a SIM swap of an employee phone account let attackers intercept authentication codes and drain exchange wallets across Ethereum and Solana. Public reporting places the theft between about $400 million and more than $600 million, but the exact reconciled loss remains unsettled. A SIM-swap takeover of an FTX employee’s cellular account let the attacker receive authentication codes and use that access to authorize unauthorized wallet transfers. No contract bug has been identified in the available evidence; the failure was in the identity and access boundary around high-value wallet operations.
